_doc: Ashfall horde buildings atlas v1. See buildings/HANDOFF-buildings.md. rect = [x,y,w,h] in the atlas. Base frames: anchor = bottom-centre of the footprint inside the rect; footprint_origin = top-left corner of the footprint inside the rect, so draw at (tx*32 - footprint_origin[0], ty*32 - footprint_origin[1]). Sprites may rise above the footprint. Top frames (turret/bone spire heads): anchor = rotation pivot; draw the pivot at base rect + turret_mount. Pad frames: 32x32 ground decal for the dock pad tile. shadow: drawn by the engine first, 30% black, offset (+3,+3) from the footprint. No baked shadow. Remote setup (HANDOFF-buildings §12): refinery base deploy_0..3 + fx deploy_dust 0..3, packed below the last used row.
